task: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, open the antique trunk. Then, recover the old key from the antique trunk. After that, check that the wooden door inside the bedroom is unlocked with the old key. And then, open the wooden door within the bedroom. Then, go east. And then, make an effort to go south. Then, pick up the half of a bag of chips from the couch within the living room. Then, try to head north. And then, rest the half of a bag of chips on the stove. And if you do that, you're the winner!
